From ab762f937db92034ed1a2d9ff7b6be73bd8b4f46 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Christophe JAILLET <christophe.jaillet@wanadoo.fr>
Date: Sat, 13 Jan 2024 15:58:21 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] drm/amd/display: Fix a switch statement in
 populate_dml_output_cfg_from_stream_state()

It is likely that the statement related to 'dml_edp' is misplaced. So move
it in the correct "case SIGNAL_TYPE_EDP".

Fixes: 7966f319c66d ("drm/amd/display: Introduce DML2")
Signed-off-by: Christophe JAILLET <christophe.jaillet@wanadoo.fr>
Signed-off-by: Hamza Mahfooz <hamza.mahfooz@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/dc/dml2/dml2_translation_helper.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/dc/dml2/dml2_translation_helper.c
index fa6a93dd9629..64d01a9cd68c 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/dc/dml2/dml2_translation_helper.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/dc/dml2/dml2_translation_helper.c
@@ -626,8 +626,8 @@ static void populate_dml_output_cfg_from_stream_state(struct dml_output_cfg_st *
 		if (is_dp2p0_output_encoder(pipe))
 			out->OutputEncoder[location] = dml_dp2p0;
 		break;
-		out->OutputEncoder[location] = dml_edp;
 	case SIGNAL_TYPE_EDP:
+		out->OutputEncoder[location] = dml_edp;
 		break;
 	case SIGNAL_TYPE_HDMI_TYPE_A:
 	case SIGNAL_TYPE_DVI_SINGLE_LINK:
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File Modified**: `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/dc/dml2/dml2_translation_helper.c`
   - **Change Made**: The assignment of `out->OutputEncoder[location] = dml_edp;` was moved from its original position (after the `break;` statement) to the correct case block for `SIGNAL_TYPE_EDP`. This ensures that the `dml_edp` assignment is executed when the signal type is `EDP`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification addresses a bug where the assignment of `dml_edp` was incorrectly placed outside of the `SIGNAL_TYPE_EDP` case in a switch statement. By moving this line into the correct case, the code now properly assigns the `dml_edp` value when the signal type is `EDP`, thereby fixing the logic of the function `populate_dml_output_cfg_from_stream_state()`. This change is directly related to the functionality of the display driver, ensuring that the output configuration is set correctly based on the signal type.
